title: Label registration path identity failures and document the helper contract
outcome: Registration path identity errors identify the failing host or receipt field, with a concise helper contract explaining native realpath and fail-closed throwing behavior.
acceptance: The helper documents why native realpath is required and why invalid/unavailable operands throw instead of returning a comparable sentinel.
Diagnostics name the failing registration path field while preserving identity checks, refusal behavior, budgets and retry bounds.
